mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in federal funds rates signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers labor market recovery, boosting growth expectations and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns not positive when UNRATE falls below 4.0% in a 60-day window, or if other macro factors negate the labor recovery signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDP demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (RSAFS) above recent averages signal robust demand, prompting short-term (5-day) positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The interaction of GDPC1 and RSAFS above thresholds does not correlate with positive 5-day returns, or one proxy rises while the other does not.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained surge in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 104 indicates stronger supply-side growth, prompting positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses above 104 without subsequent positive 20-day returns, or inflation spikes counteract supply-side gains.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle regime, sustained declines in federal funds rates lower discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In the monetary easing cycle regime, FEDFUNDS declines do not translate to higher returns, or returns remain negative despite the easing.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in unemployment rate below 4.0% reflect improving labor market conditions, fostering growth and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE continues to fall below 4.0% but S&P 500 returns remain negative over 20 days, or other factors dominate the labor recovery signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above recent averages signal robust demand, prompting short-term (5-day) positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The interaction of GDPC1 and HOUST above thresholds does not correlate with positive 5-day returns, or one proxy rises while the other does not.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) above 24,000 billion chained 2017 dollars indicates strong economic momentum, prompting positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 exceeds 24,000 without positive 20-day returns, or inflationary pressures negate the demand surge.
